value: Pettenderly is an online AI pet portrait studio for cat and dog owners. Upload one to five photos of the same pet, choose a watercolor, royal or studio style, and download a digital portrait. The Starter Pack costs $4.99 for 12 non-expiring credits. Each successful image uses one credit; failed generations do not consume credits. Pro plans provide 40 credits per month. You & your pet and photo cleanup are beta features. Faces, coat markings and fine details may vary. Digital downloads only; physical printing is not included.
AI pet portraits, cat portraits, dog portraits, pet photo editor
Create downloadable AI pet portraits from your cat or dog photos with Pettenderly. Choose watercolor, royal or studio styles.
